aliases: IEEE With Mechanical Block and Manual Unlatching
summary: IEEE-library form of manually unlatched nc contact: a manually unlatched NC contact has a mechanical retained state and a documented manual release.
description: This reference locates manually unlatched nc contact in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented relays and contacts family. A manually unlatched NC contact has a mechanical retained state and a documented manual release. Its reference state is closed but the retained operated position must be stated. The public library uses HCR2221F for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace the measured quantity or initiating control signal separately from the output contacts. The device tag links the sensing or operating element to the controlled circuit; settings, reset behaviour and the actual terminal arrangement belong in the selected equipment documentation.

Confirm which contact position the mechanism retains. A mechanical retention marker must not be confused with a delayed-return timer marker. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
